hall.text:
The lift opens on a hall of mirrors. Two doors wait at the end: one glows red, one glows blue.

Somewhere behind you, the lift doors close for good.

red.text: Behind the red door: an empty shaft and a long, long fall.

blue.text: A stairway lit by blue runes climbs into the dark.

roof.text: The stairs end on a rooftop. Rain, wind, and a waiting airship. You made it.
